reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that recognizes pasted images through Zhipu GLM-4V, displays image attachments, and injects recognition results into conversation context; human review is warranted because it transmits images externally, stores API keys unencrypted, and can modify a local checkout.

summaries.zh: 通过智谱 GLM-4V 识别粘贴到 DeepSeek Harness 中的图片，并将识别结果注入对话上下文。
summaries.en: Recognizes images pasted into DeepSeek Harness with Zhipu GLM-4V and injects the results into the conversation context.

capabilities: forwards pasted images to the Zhipu GLM-4V API for recognition
stores API keys in an unencrypted local JSON file
injects recognition results into conversation context
automatically modifies a local dsh checkout to apply an attachment-authorization patch
